verdict.rationale: Bento documents an API reference browser for scanning endpoints, request fields, and response fields alongside hand-written docs, with per-endpoint pages such as POST /batch/subscribers and POST /batch/events. Runnable calls are covered through a Postman Collection spanning every endpoint, but that means using an external tool rather than in-page execution. Missing for 10: evidence of in-browser 'try it' execution, runnable code examples embedded in the reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
